label: 🖼️ IMAGEN / CONCEPTO, TODAVÍA HAY QUE CONSTRUIRLO

skeleton.type: custom Blender armature (Meshy auto-rig is humanoid only)

skin: Blender bone-heat weights, fallback nearest-bone distance weights for any unweighted vertex

fly.note: wings open and flap (+-50 deg), legs tucked; loop

takeoff.note: crouch 5 f, jump, wings open by f8, rises to fly height (0.6x body height) at f18; chain into fly

move_speed_note: root speed matching the planted foot of the in-place cycle; drive the animal at this speed to avoid skating

behaviour.suggested_route: flock of 4-8 in the cathedral square and market; peck, short walks, flush away (takeoff -> fly) when the player or a cart comes within 2.5 m, land 6-10 cells away
behaviour.rule: always moving or doing something; never idle in place more than ~15 s

textures: baseColor + normal + ORM from Tripo, 1024/512/256 for LOD0/1/2

wing_meshes.note: separate open-wing card meshes (40 tris, own 256x128 feather texture sampled from the wing colours, double-sided), skinned 100% to wing_open_*; bone scale 0.01 = hidden in all ground clips, 1.0 in takeoff/fly
